text: has a built-in filter and is super easy to use. I have had two not inexpensive Keurig K-cup coffee systems in the last 18 months.  My nephew uses a French Press, so I thought I'd give it a try as an alternative.  The SterlingPro is a champ!  It is sleek, well-designed, Insulated, has a built-in filter and is super easy to use.  You can brew up to two good sized (14 oz. +) cups of coffee at once (just takes a couple of minutes longer than the Keurig.)  And the best part is, the coffee is really great!  I think I actually enjoy it more.  It also creates less waste for the landfill.  I would recommend the SterlingPro French Press to anyone who enjoys a good home brewed cup of coffee.
